methods.name: Itinerary transcription and mode coding
methods.why: Use route books and contemporary reports to classify wagon, rail, or unknown rather than inferring mode from proximity.

methods.name: Town-year comparison
methods.why: Compare visited and unvisited eligible towns by population and dated rail access, accounting for show and year and reporting bias.

methods.name: Historical map georeferencing
methods.why: Validate station and road locations with period maps and distinguish missing data from absence.

next_steps: Find pre-1875 route books and newspapers and document show transport explicitly.
Define eligible towns and record uncertainty in digitization coverage and station dates.
Validate 1912–1916 rail access with period maps.
